description: Use this when the user wants to set Tenda up for their company, or has just added Tenda and has no workspace yet: shows a short form in the chat for the company, where it works and the work it does, then how many open tenders fit it now. Needs a Tenda account. Do not use to change one fact the user names, such as a certification (use save_company_profile).

workspace.description: The Tenda workspace to set up, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: set_up_tenda
title: Set up Tenda
